name: 32806-shortdecode-llama4scout-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism.
architecture: Llama4ForConditionalGeneration, text path only. FP8 mixture of experts, 109B total parameters and ~17B active per token, ~107 GB of weight files. 16 routed experts plus one always-resident shared expert per layer.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 25%, no cooldown.
workload: short-prompt, medium-output pure decode: exactly 32 prompt tokens and exactly 128 output tokens per request, fixed rather than sampled (the backend sets max_tokens and ignore_eos), 320 requests of which 25% are warmup, sampling temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0.
purpose: A snippet-expansion writing assistant turning brief prompts into short passages for eight concurrent users on two GPUs.
launch:
# ~107 GB of FP8 weights do not fit on one 80 GB H100: TP=2 is the smallest topology here that
# holds the model. Fall back to TP=4 if TP=2 will not initialise on this node.
model: RedHatAI/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct-FP8-dynamic
max-num-seqs: 256
max-model-len: 1024
tensor-parallel-size: 2
